source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 8 (PDF 194-206), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Online Research and Digital Literacy) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
8.1 Introduction to Online Research and Digital Literacy

blocks.prompt:
1 The activity of finding information on the internet about a particular topic is called:
(Internet par kisi khaas mauzu ke bare mein maloomat dhoondne ke amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Online research internet par kisi mauzu ki maloomat dhoondna hai, articles, reports ya videos jaise zariye istemal kar ke.

book_ref.quote: Online research is the activity of finding information on the internet about a particular topic.

blocks.prompt:
2 The goal of online research is to collect information that is:
(Online research ka maqsad kaisi maloomat jama karna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka maqsad durust, qabil-e-aitbaar aur taaza maloomat jama karna hai jo mauzu samajhne ya masla hal karne mein madad de.

book_ref.quote: The goal of online research is to collect correct, trustworthy, and current information

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of these is given in the chapter as a reliable source for online research?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein online research ka qabil-e-aitbaar zariya bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: aisi website jis ka likhne wala maloom na ho

blocks.explanation: Qabil-e-aitbaar zariye: official government websites, taleemi idare aur mashhoor akhbaraat.

book_ref.quote: This can include official government websites, educational institutions, or well-known newspapers.

blocks.prompt:
4 How can a researcher ensure the accuracy of online findings?
(Researcher online nataij ki durusti kaise yaqeeni bana sakta hai?)

options.text: sirf pehla search result le kar
aik website poori naql kar ke
kai zariyon ki maloomat ka muqabla kar ke

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif zariyon ki maloomat ka muqabla kar ke nataij ki durusti yaqeeni banai ja sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: By comparing information from multiple sources, one can ensure the accuracy of the findings.

blocks.prompt:
5 Why must information be taken from reliable sources during online research?
(Online research mein maloomat qabil-e-aitbaar zariyon se kyun leni chahiye?)

options.text: Internet ki har maloomat durust nahin; kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah kun details deti hain
Saari websites hamesha durust hoti hain
Qabil-e-aitbaar zariye hamesha tez hote hain
Search engines ghalat pages mita dete hain

blocks.explanation: Internet ki saari maloomat durust nahin; kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah kun details deti hain, is liye qabil-e-aitbaar zariye zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: Some websites may provide false or misleading details.

blocks.prompt:
6 According to the chapter, online research helps professionals to:
(Chapter ke mutabiq online research professionals ki kis kaam mein madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Online research students ko homework, professionals ko apne shobe mein update rehne aur sab ko soch samajh kar faislay karne mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: allows professionals to stay updated in their fields

blocks.prompt:
7 Finding basic information on a topic to get an overview, for example through articles, blog posts or videos, is:
(Kisi mauzu par bunyadi maloomat dhoond kar mukhtasar jaiza lena, maslan articles, blog posts ya videos se, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: General information research mauzu ki bunyadi maloomat dhoondti hai aur mukhtasar jaize ya ahem nukaat ke liye mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: It is useful for gaining an overview or understanding the main points.

blocks.prompt:
8 Searching for books, research papers or articles from libraries or databases for educational purposes is:
(Taleemi maqsad ke liye libraries ya databases se kitabein, research papers ya articles dhoondna kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Academic research taleemi maqsad ke liye taleemi websites, libraries ya databases se ilmi maloomat dhoondti hai.

book_ref.quote: This type of research focuses on finding scholarly information for educational purposes.

blocks.prompt:
9 Which type of online research provides detailed and reliable information often written by experts?
(Online research ki kaun si qism tafseeli aur qabil-e-aitbaar maloomat deti hai jo aksar mahireen likhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Academic research tafseeli aur qabil-e-aitbaar maloomat deti hai jo aksar mahireen ki likhi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Academic research provides detailed and reliable information that is often written by experts.

blocks.prompt:
10 A company studies customer behaviour and its competitors before launching a new product. This is:
(Aik company naya product launch karne se pehle gahakon ke rawaiye aur muqabil companies ka jaiza leti hai. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Market research karobar aur entrepreneurs market ke rujhanat, gahakon ke rawaiye aur muqable ko samajhne ke liye karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This type is used by businesses and entrepreneurs to understand market trends

blocks.prompt:
11 Checking several reliable sources to confirm whether a news claim is correct is:
(Kai qabil-e-aitbaar zariye dekh kar tasdeeq karna ke koi khabar durust hai ya nahin, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fact-checking research kai qabil-e-aitbaar zariyon se tasdeeq karti hai ke maloomat durust hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: This type is used to verify if the information is accurate.

blocks.prompt:
12 Learning about symptoms and treatments from reliable health websites and medical journals is:
(Qabil-e-aitbaar health websites aur medical journals se alamaat aur ilaaj ke bare mein janna kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Health research sehat ke masail, ilaaj ya healthcare services ki maloomat qabil-e-aitbaar health websites aur medical journals se dhoondti hai.

book_ref.quote: by using reliable health websites and medical journals

blocks.prompt:
13 Online research is divided into different types on the basis of:
(Online research ko mukhtalif qismon mein kis bunyad par taqseem kiya jata hai?)

options.text: maqsad aur zaroori maloomat ki qism

blocks.explanation: Online research maqsad aur zaroori maloomat ki qism ki bunyad par taqseem hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Online research can be categorized into different types based on the purpose

blocks.prompt:
14 The ability to use digital tools such as computers, smartphones and the internet to find, understand, create and share information is:
(Computers, smartphones aur internet jaise digital tools se maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ki salahiyat:)
blocks.explanation: Digital literacy digital tools se maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ki salahiyat hai.

book_ref.quote: Digital literacy is the ability to use digital tools

blocks.prompt:
15 In the science project example, digital literacy helps the student to:
(Science project ki misal mein digital literacy student ki kis kaam mein madad karti hai?)

options.text: faisla karna ke mile hue zariye qabil-e-aitbaar hain

blocks.explanation: Digital literacy student ko faisla karne mein madad deti hai ke zariye qabil-e-aitbaar hain, maslan article university ya mashhoor idare ka hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: Digital literacy helps the student decide whether the sources found are trustworthy

blocks.prompt:
16 Which of these skills is part of digital literacy?
(In mein se kaun si salahiyat digital literacy ka hissa hai?)

options.text: digital platforms par zaati maloomat ki hifazat

blocks.explanation: Digital literacy mein search engines istemal karna, zariyon ki jaanch aur digital platforms par zaati maloomat ki hifazat shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: protecting personal information while using digital platforms

blocks.prompt:
17 Knowing how to open programs, use applications and navigate websites is the digital literacy component called:
(Programs kholna, applications chalana aur websites par ghoomna digital literacy ka kaun sa hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Using technology yani computers, tablets aur smartphones chalana: programs kholna, applications istemal karna, websites par jana.

book_ref.quote: It includes knowing how to open programs, use applications, and navigate websites.

blocks.prompt:
18 A farmer in Punjab types "modern irrigation techniques for wheat" into Google. Which component of digital literacy is he using?
(Punjab ka aik kisan Google par "modern irrigation techniques for wheat" likhta hai. Woh digital literacy ka kaun sa hissa istemal kar raha hai?)
blocks.explanation: Searching for information yani search engine mein munasib keywords likhna aur nataij ko behtar karna.

book_ref.quote: This skill includes entering relevant keywords and refining search results

blocks.prompt:
19 A teacher in Lahore checks whether a website about educational methods is run by an educational institution before using it. This is:
(Lahore ki aik teacher taleemi tareeqon wali website istemal karne se pehle dekhti hai ke yeh kisi taleemi idare ki hai ya nahin. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Evaluating sources yani dekhna ke online maloomat qabil-e-aitbaar hai: kis ne banai aur zariya bharose ke qabil hai ya nahin.

book_ref.quote: They check if the website is run by an educational institution or a credible organization

blocks.prompt:
20 A student in Karachi makes a PowerPoint presentation with slides, text and images. Which component of digital literacy is this?
(Karachi ka aik student slides, text aur images ke saath PowerPoint presentation banata hai. Yeh digital literacy ka kaun sa hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Creating digital content yani apna mawad banana, jaise articles, presentations ya edit ki hui tasveerein.

book_ref.quote: A student in Karachi creates a PowerPoint presentation for a class project.

blocks.prompt:
21 A person in Islamabad sets privacy settings on social media and avoids suspicious links. Which component is this?
(Islamabad ka aik shakhs social media par privacy settings lagata hai aur mashkook links se bachta hai. Yeh kaun sa hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Online safety aur privacy zaati maloomat ki hifazat aur internet par mehfooz rehna hai.

book_ref.quote: sets their privacy settings to control who can see their personal information

blocks.prompt:
22 Using strong passwords and recognizing possible online threats belong to which component of digital literacy?
(Mazboot passwords istemal karna aur mumkina online khatraat pehchanna digital literacy ke kis hisse mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Online safety aur privacy mein mazboot passwords aur mumkina online khatraat ki pehchan shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: This includes using strong passwords and recognizing potential online threats.

blocks.prompt:
23 Creating digital content requires:
(Digital content banane ke liye kis cheez ki zaroorat hai?)

options.text: mukhtalif software aur tools ka ilm

blocks.explanation: Digital content banane (articles, presentations, photo editing) ke liye mukhtalif software aur tools ka ilm chahiye.

book_ref.quote: It requires knowledge of different software and tools.

blocks.text: 8.1.5 Advanced Information Retrieval Techniques (search engines, keywords, Boolean operators, advanced search features)

blocks.prompt:
24 Instead of typing "recipes", typing "traditional pakistani recipes" in a search engine gives:
(Search engine mein "recipes" ke bajaye "traditional pakistani recipes" likhne se kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada wazeh query jaise "traditional pakistani recipes" se zyada khaas nataij milte hain.

book_ref.quote: to get more specific results

blocks.prompt:
25 The words you type into a search engine are called:
(Search engine mein likhe jane wale alfaaz ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Keywords woh alfaaz hain jo search engine mein likhe jate hain; sahi keywords se munasib maloomat jaldi milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Keywords are the words you type into a search engine.

blocks.prompt:
26 A farmer wants to learn organic farming techniques. Which keywords will give more relevant information?
(Aik kisan organic farming ke tareeqe seekhna chahta hai. Kaun se keywords zyada munasib maloomat denge?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf "farming" ke bajaye "organic farming" likhne se zyada munasib maloomat milti hai.

book_ref.quote: the farmer will find more relevant information

blocks.prompt:
27 Which of the following are the Boolean operators used to refine a search?
(In mein se kaun se Boolean operators search ko behtar karne ke liye istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Boolean operators khaas alfaaz hain jo search ko behtar karte hain: AND, OR aur NOT.

book_ref.quote: Boolean operators are special words that help you refine your search.

blocks.prompt:
28 To get results that contain both the terms solar and energy, the search should be:
(Aise nataij ke liye jin mein solar aur energy dono alfaaz hon, search kaisi honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: AND kai alfaaz shamil karta hai: "agriculture AND irrigation" se woh nataij milte hain jin mein dono alfaaz hon.

book_ref.quote: AND is used to include multiple terms in your search.

blocks.prompt:
29 The search "Crops OR vegetables" shows results that include:
("Crops OR vegetables" search kaun se nataij dikhati hai?)

options.text: dono mein se koi bhi aik lafz

blocks.explanation: OR un nataij ko dhoondta hai jin mein dono mein se koi aik lafz ho.

book_ref.quote: OR is used to find results that include either of the terms.

blocks.prompt:
30 Search engine features that filter results by date and location are called:
(Search engine ke woh features jo nataij ko date aur location se filter karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Advanced search features nataij ko date, location waghera se filter karte hain taake sab se munasib aur taaza maloomat mile.

book_ref.quote: allow you to filter results by date, location, and more

blocks.prompt:
31 To find the latest news on Pakistan's education policy, a student should:
(Pakistan ki education policy ki taaza khabrein dhoondne ke liye student ko kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: news ke lafz ke saath NOT lagana
advanced search mein pichle saal ka filter lagana

blocks.explanation: Advanced search feature se nataij ko pichle saal tak filter karne se sab se taaza articles milte hain.

book_ref.quote: filter results by the past year to find the most recent articles

blocks.prompt:
32 According to the chapter, what portion of the world's population uses the internet?
(Chapter ke mutabiq duniya ki aabadi ka kitna hissa internet istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Duniya ki aadhi se zyada aabadi internet istemal karti hai, is liye achhi online research aik taqatwar zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: Did you know that more than half of the world

blocks.prompt:
33 The process of creating questions that guide your research is called:
(Research ki rehnumai karne wale sawal banane ke amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Formulating research inquiries woh sawal banana hai jo research ki rehnumai karein aur batayein ke kya seekhna hai.

book_ref.quote: Formulating research inquiries is the process of creating questions that guide your research.

blocks.prompt:
34 According to the chapter, the first step to a successful research project is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq kamyab research project ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Achha research sawal banana pehla qadam hai; soch samajh kar bana sawal poori study ki simt tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: formulating good research questions is the first step to a successful research project

blocks.prompt:
35 In the chapter's class activity, after writing a specific research question the student develops a hypothesis that:
(Chapter ki class activity mein khaas research sawal likhne ke baad student aisa hypothesis banata hai jo:)

options.text: research se test kiya ja sake
website se naql kiya gaya ho
research ke baghair aakhri jawab ho

blocks.explanation: Research sawal ki bunyad par student aisa hypothesis (qiyas) banata hai jise research se test kiya ja sake.

book_ref.quote: develop a hypothesis that you could test through research

blocks.prompt:
36 Asking the right questions and making informed guesses helps you to:
(Sahi sawal poochna aur soch samajh kar andaza lagana aap ki kis kaam mein madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sahi sawal aur soch samajh kar andaze se aap bamaani research projects design kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: making informed guesses, you can design meaningful research projects

blocks.prompt:
37 Effectively using tools and information available on the internet, such as articles, videos and websites, to support work or learning is:
(Kaam ya taleem mein madad ke liye internet par maujood tools aur maloomat (articles, videos, websites) ka achha istemal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Utilizing digital resources internet ke tools aur maloomat ka kaam ya taleem ke liye achha istemal hai.

book_ref.quote: Utilizing digital resources means effectively using tools and information available on the internet

blocks.prompt:
38 Collections of articles written by experts in various fields are called:
(Mukhtalif shobon ke mahireen ke likhe articles ke majmuon ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Academic journals mukhtalif shobon ke mahireen ke likhe articles ke majmue hain.

book_ref.quote: Academic journals are collections of articles written by experts in various fields.

blocks.prompt:
39 A student can access many academic journals online through:
(Student bohat se academic journals online kis zariye hasil kar sakta hai?)

options.text: school libraries, university portals ya open-access websites

blocks.explanation: Students bohat se academic journals school libraries, university portals ya open-access websites se online parh sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: through school libraries, university portals, or open-access websites

blocks.prompt:
40 Which websites are named in the chapter as offering free access to some academic papers?
(Chapter mein kaun si websites ka naam hai jo kuch academic papers muft parhne deti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Google Scholar ya ResearchGate jaisi websites kuch academic papers muft deti hain.

book_ref.quote: websites like Google Scholar or ResearchGate offer free access to some academic papers

blocks.prompt:
41 To research the effects of pollution on local ecosystems, which journals should you search?
(Maqami ecosystems par aaloodgi ke asraat ki research ke liye kaun se journals dhoondne chahiye?)

options.text: environmental science ki studies wale journals

blocks.explanation: Aaloodgi aur ecosystems ke liye environmental science ki studies shaya karne wale academic journals dhoondein.

book_ref.quote: you might search for academic journals that publish studies on environmental science

blocks.text: 8.3.2 Effective Navigation and Managing Digital Information

blocks.prompt:
42 Online libraries and databases offer filters to search by:
(Online libraries aur databases kin cheezon se search ke filters dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat si online libraries aur databases date, author ya subject se search ke filters deti hain.

book_ref.quote: offer filters to help you search by date, author, or subject

blocks.prompt:
43 Which tools help a researcher stay organized while managing digital information?
(Digital maloomat sambhalte waqt kaun se tools researcher ko munazzam rehne mein madad dete hain?)

options.text: digital folders, note-taking apps aur reference managers

blocks.explanation: Digital folders, note-taking apps ya reference managers munazzam rehne aur research aasan karne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Using digital folders, note-taking apps, or reference managers helps you stay organized

blocks.prompt:
44 Which of these is a good way to manage information after finding useful online resources?
(Mufeed online resources milne ke baad maloomat sambhalne ka achha tareeqa kaun sa hai?)

options.text: copies save karna, ahem nukaat ke notes lena aur zariyon ka record rakhna
parhne ke baad zariye mita dena
sab kuch aik lambi be-naam file mein rakhna
notes ke baghair sab yaad rakhna

blocks.explanation: Articles ki digital copies save aur munazzam karein, ahem nukaat ke notes lein aur apne zariyon ka record rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Once you have found useful resources, managing the information is crucial.

blocks.prompt:
45 The principles and guidelines that researchers follow to make their work honest, respectful and fair are called:
(Woh usool aur hidayat jin par researchers apna kaam imandar, ba-izzat aur munsifana banane ke liye amal karte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Research ethics woh usool aur hidayat hain jo research ko imandar, ba-izzat aur munsifana rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Research ethics are the principles and guidelines that researchers follow

blocks.prompt:
46 In a survey of classmates' study habits, research ethics require you to:
(Hum jamaaton ki parhai ki aadaton ke survey mein research ethics kya taqaza karte hain?)

options.text: naamon ke saath jawabat shaya karna
apni soch ke mutabiq jawab badalna
un ki ijazat lena aur jawabat raaz mein rakhna

blocks.explanation: Research ethics taqaza karte hain ke zaati maloomat lene se pehle ijazat li jaye aur jawabat raaz mein rakhe jayen.

book_ref.quote: Research ethics would require you to ask for their permission before collecting any personal information

blocks.prompt:
47 Copying someone else's work without giving them credit is called:
(Kisi doosre ka kaam credit diye baghair naql karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre ka kaam credit diye baghair naql karna plagiarism (adabi chori) hai; yeh ghair akhlaqi hai.

book_ref.quote: copy someone else's work without giving them credit (plagiarism)

blocks.prompt:
48 Following ethical guidelines in research:
(Research mein akhlaqi hidayat par amal karne se:)

options.text: nataij ko qabil-e-aitbaar aur mo'tabar banata hai
zariyon ki zaroorat khatam karta hai
data badalne ki ijazat deta hai

blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi research qabil-e-aitbaar nataij deti hai aur nataij ki saakh aur bharosa barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethical research also contributes to the credibility and reliability of the results

blocks.prompt:
49 Besides leading to wrong conclusions, falsifying data would:
(Ghalat nataij ke ilawa data mein jaal-saazi (falsify) karne se aur kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Data mein jaal-saazi ya plagiarism se ghalat nataij nikal sakte hain aur researcher ki saakh kharab hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: it would also damage your reputation as a researcher

blocks.prompt:
50 Telling participants the purpose of the research and getting their permission before involving them is the principle of:
(Shurakaa ko research ka maqsad batana aur shamil karne se pehle ijazat lena kis usool mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Informed consent: shurakaa ko research ka maqsad batayein aur pehle un ki ijazat lein.

book_ref.quote: obtain their permission before involving them in your study

blocks.prompt:
51 Keeping participants' personal information and responses private is the principle of:
(Shurakaa ki zaati maloomat aur jawabat raaz mein rakhna kis usool mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Confidentiality: zaati maloomat aur jawabat raaz mein rakhein aur ijazat ke baghair share na karein.

book_ref.quote: Keep personal information and responses of participants private

blocks.prompt:
52 Treating all participants with respect and making sure the research does not harm them is the principle of:
(Tamam shurakaa se izzat se pesh aana aur yaqeeni banana ke research unhein nuqsan na de, kis usool mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Respect for participants: sab shurakaa se izzat se pesh aayen aur research se unhein koi nuqsan na ho.

book_ref.quote: ensure that your research does not harm them in any way

blocks.prompt:
53 Conducting research fairly and basing conclusions on the evidence gathered is the principle of:
(Research munsifana tareeqe se karna aur nataij jama shuda saboot par rakhna kis usool mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Avoiding bias: research munsifana aur be-laag andaz mein karein aur nataij saboot par mabni hon.

book_ref.quote: make sure your conclusions are based on the evidence you gather

blocks.prompt:
54 Intellectual Property (IP) refers to:
(Intellectual Property (IP) se kya muraad hai?)

options.text: zehan ki takhleeqat ki hifazat ke qanooni haqooq

blocks.explanation: IP woh qanooni haqooq hain jo zehan ki takhleeqat ki hifazat karte hain, jaise ijadat, tehreerein, designs, symbols, naam aur karobari tasaveer.

book_ref.quote: refers to the legal rights that protect creations of the mind

blocks.prompt:
55 Intellectual property rights allow creators to:
(Intellectual property ke haqooq takhleeq karne walon ko kya dete hain?)

options.text: apne kaam par ikhtiyar aur us se munafa

blocks.explanation: IP haqooq takhleeq karne walon ko apne kaam par ikhtiyar aur us se munafa dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These rights allow creators to control and profit from their work

blocks.text: 8.5.1 Types of Intellectual Property (as printed; patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs, trade secrets)

blocks.prompt:
56 An exclusive right granted for an invention that gives a new way of doing something is a:
(Aisi ijad ke liye diya gaya khaas haq jo kaam karne ka naya tareeqa de:)
blocks.explanation: Patent ijad ke liye khaas haq hai, aisa product ya process jo naya tareeqa ya naya technical hal de.

book_ref.quote: A patent is an exclusive right granted for an invention

blocks.prompt:
57 A Pakistani engineer invents a more efficient solar panel. Which IP protection stops others from making or selling it without permission?
(Aik Pakistani engineer zyada behtar solar panel ijad karta hai. Kaun si IP hifazat doosron ko ijazat ke baghair use banane ya bechne se rokti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patent doosron ko kuch saalon tak mojid ki ijazat ke baghair ijad banane, istemal karne ya bechne se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: A patent prevents others from making, using, or selling the invention

blocks.prompt:
58 The logo of National Foods that helps customers recognize the brand on spices and sauces is a:
(National Foods ka logo jo gahakon ko masalon aur sauces par brand pehchanne mein madad deta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Trademark aik nishan, logo ya naam hai jo aik company ki ashya ya services ko doosron se alag karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The logo of National Foods is a trademark

blocks.prompt:
59 Trademarks are essential for:
(Trademarks kis cheez ke liye zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Trademarks gahakon ko product ya service ka zariya pehchanne mein madad dete hain aur brand ki pehchan ke liye zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: Trademarks help consumers identify the source of a product or service

blocks.prompt:
60 Books, music, films, paintings and software are protected by:
(Kitabein, music, films, paintings aur software kis se mehfooz hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Copyright adabi aur fanni kaam jaise kitabein, music, films, paintings aur software mehfooz karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Copyright protects literary and artistic works, such as books, music, films, paintings, and software.

blocks.prompt:
61 A Pakistani author writes a novel. Under copyright, who alone may publish it or adapt it into a movie?
(Aik Pakistani musannif novel likhta hai. Copyright ke tehat sirf kaun use shaya ya film mein badal sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Copyright qanoon yaqeeni banata hai ke sirf musannif hi novel shaya karne, bechne ya film banane ka haq rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Copyright law ensures that only the author has the right to publish, sell, or adapt the novel into a movie.

blocks.prompt:
62 A designer in Karachi creates a unique, stylish bottle shape for mineral water. Which right stops other companies from using that shape?
(Karachi ka aik designer mineral water ke liye munfarid, khoobsurat bottle ki shakal banata hai. Kaun sa haq doosri companies ko yeh shakal istemal karne se rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Industrial design rights product ki zahiri banawat, shakal aur khoobsurti ki hifazat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Industrial design rights protect the visual design of objects that are not purely utilitarian.

blocks.prompt:
63 How is a trade secret different from a patent?
(Trade secret patent se kaise mukhtalif hai?)

options.text: Trade secret hamesha shaya hota hai
Trade secret logo ki hifazat karta hai
Trade secret novel ki hifazat karta hai
Trade secret awam ko nahin bataya jata

blocks.explanation: Trade secret raaz wali maloomat hai jo muqable mein bartari deti hai; patents ke bar-aks trade secrets awam ko nahin bataye jate.

book_ref.quote: Unlike patents, trade secrets are not disclosed to the public.

blocks.prompt:
64 The exact recipe of a famous soft drink, known to only a few people in the company, is an example of a:
(Mashhoor soft drink ki asal recipe jo company mein sirf chand log jante hain, kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pakola ki recipe trade secret hai: company mein sirf chand log asal ajza aur un ki miqdaar jante hain.

book_ref.quote: The recipe for a famous Pakistani soft drink, Pakola, is a trade secret.

blocks.prompt:
65 Why is intellectual property important?
(Intellectual property kyun aham hai?)

options.text: Is se koi bhi nayi ijadat naql kar sakta hai
Yeh logon ko ijad se rokti hai
Yeh logon ko naye khayalat par ubharti hai kyun ke unhein sila milega
Is se saari takhleeqat muft ho jati hain

blocks.explanation: IP ki hifazat logon ko naye khayalat aur ijadat par ubharti hai kyun ke unhein sila milega; yeh takhleeqi salahiyat aur taraqqi ko barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: This protection encourages people to keep coming up with new ideas and innovations

blocks.prompt:
66 Which organization registers and protects intellectual property rights in Pakistan?
(Pakistan mein intellectual property ke haqooq kaun sa idara register aur mehfooz karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan ka Intellectual Property Organization (IPO) mulk mein IP haqooq register aur mehfooz karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Did you know that Pakistan has its own Intellectual Property Organization (IPO)?

blocks.text: 8.5.3 How to Protect Your Intellectual Property

blocks.prompt:
67 If you invent something new in Pakistan, you protect it by:
(Agar aap Pakistan mein koi nayi cheez ijad karein to us ki hifazat kaise karenge?)

options.text: IPO Pakistan ke zariye patent ki darkhwast
kitab ke copyright ke taur par register karna

blocks.explanation: Ijad ki hifazat ke liye IPO Pakistan ke zariye patent ki darkhwast dein.

book_ref.quote: If you invent something new, apply for a patent through the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan

blocks.prompt:
68 To stop others from using your brand name, logo or slogan, you should:
(Doosron ko apna brand naam, logo ya slogan istemal karne se rokne ke liye aap ko kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: use trademark ke taur par register karna

blocks.explanation: Apna brand naam, logo ya slogan trademark ke taur par register karein taake doosre use istemal na karein.

book_ref.quote: Register your brand name, logo, or slogan as a trademark

blocks.prompt:
69 Creative works are protected under copyright by:
(Takhleeqi kaam copyright ke tehat kaise mehfooz kiye jate hain?)

options.text: munasib idare ke paas register karwa kar
un par dastakhat na kar ke
naam ke baghair share kar ke

blocks.explanation: Copyright ke liye apne takhleeqi kaam munasib idare ke paas register karwa kar mehfooz karein.

book_ref.quote: Ensure your creative works are protected by registering them with the appropriate authority.
